title: Demo controls
notice: Everything here is simulated. DUMMY server, sign-in and memory. No real proof, rewards or providers.
resetHint: Each scenario starts from scratch and clears all demo data.
new: New player: sign-in and first steps
empty: Player after first steps, no character yet
returning: Returning player with characters and Oaths
offline: Simulate: the phone loses its internet connection
expire: Simulate: the session expires and the app asks you to sign in again
lose: Simulate: the reply to the next Oath gets lost in transit
armed: ✓ Armed. Now make an Oath in the Forge or create a character. The server saves it, but the app gets no reply.
loseProof: Simulate: the reply to the next proof gets lost in transit
proofArmed: ✓ Armed. Now send proof for an Oath. The server keeps it, and sending again returns the same receipt.
loseRecordClear: Simulate: saving on this phone fails after the next Oath
recordClearArmed: ✓ Armed. Now make an Oath in the Forge. The server confirms it, but the phone keeps an unfinished record, so the screen offers Check confirmation.
addHint: To see a new Oath, pull the Today list down.
add: Add an active Oath to the current character
addNeedsMore: Add an Oath that needs more proof
restart: Restart the app, demo data stays
wireCheck: Developer check: send proof to a local test server (DUMMY)
wireCheckNotice: Proof goes to the test server with a DUMMY token. Start that server first. Address:
